chunks: And Abdul Wahid ibn Abdullah informed us, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Rabah al-Zuhri informed us from Muhammad ibn al-Abbas al-Hasani from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abu Hamza al-Bata'i from Muhammad al-Khazzaz, who said: Abu Abdullah said:
He who spreads our traditions among us is in the same rank as one who denies our right.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of spreading the secret traditions of the Imams?
ai.summary: In the context of the Minor and Major Occultation, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a high spiritual stakes for the preservation of Hadith, equating the public dissemination of their secret traditions with the denial of their divine right (Haqq). This narration underscores the scholarly principle that while knowledge is shared, the 'secret' or esoteric aspects of the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings require careful stewardship to maintain their sanctity and authority among the faithful.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (6) Abdul Wahid bin Abdullah narrated from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Rabah az-Zuhri from Muhammad bin al-Abbas al-Hasani from al-Hasan bin Ali bin Abu Hamza al-Bata’ini from Muhammad al-Kharraz that Abu Abdullah (Imam as-Sadiq) had said: “
He, who spreads our (secret) traditions, is like one, who denies our right.”
